create_oneshot_tool_manager: create a OneShotToolManager instance with a list of Tool objects to orchestrate tool usage
execute_tool_from_model_output: parse model output and execute the referenced tool via maybe_execute_tool on a OneShotToolManager
generate_system_prompt_for_tools: generate a system prompt string from a OneShotToolManager that lists all available tools and their formats
format_tool_instructions: format a Tool object into a readable instruction string with description, call format, and example
update_registered_tools: replace the current list of registered tools on a ToolManagerBase instance with new ones
